Competing reading fuses *for ever* on the pair under rule 30, headed on עַד/ever; the accepted fusion was internally inconsistent (source head on the construct, target head on the word realizing the absolute).

review_notes: Corrected עֲדֵי־עַד: the accepted unit fused *for ever* with source head on the construct עֲדֵי but target head on *ever*, which realizes the absolute עַד; each morpheme has a word of its own (*for* for the extent construct, *ever* for 'perpetuity'), so rule 2 splits them on the model of rule 26's *and for evermore*. Fused reading with head on עַד/*ever* named as the competing one.
